results.name: T200 Dieselpunk Mech - Freebie
results.description:
The T200 Imperial Mech is equipped with two Gatling guns that can fire 80mm rounds. Up to 3 passengers can be seated in the T200 Mech. It has two searchlights that can be controlled from the inside to execute patrols.

> To say thank you to the Sketchfab team for their good work and to celebrate reaching 200 Twitter followers, I created this robot and share it with you as a freebie.
It's rigged, but the hydraulic stamps are based on constrains and they can't be exported from Cinema4D to FBX (I don't know if you can even write constraints in FBX format), so you'll have to reconfigure them yourself, but it shouldn't be hard.

results.name: Military Landvehicle Kit 1.2 (CC0)
results.description:
CC0

As sketchfab does not allow you to untick the Attribution box when uploading this model is sorted as CC-BY.

Free to use in any capacity.

Will continue updates for more parts and variation and quality.

Make a basic hull, turret or vehicle body shape. Smash a load of parts on top and there you have it, military vehicle. Some parts would also work well for machinery or construction plant.

you may need to decimate the wheels if your duplicating them a lot as it can chug out blender if you have a old PC.

1.1 Updates
* added military style parts from breakers yard kits
* added smoke grenade discharger, sand board, tool/stowage bins
* tweaked camo texture

1.2 Updates
* added bar armour, 2 snorkels, wire steps, offroad winch and mounted weapon ring
* organised objects into collections

results.name: Subway Bar
results.description:
All of the inconveniences of a food truck with none of the mobility, it's the bar and restaurant that appeals to only one specific type of person (the train hipster). 

It has a few props that can be lifted and dropped into other scenes like cardboard boxes, metal shelving, kegs and faucets, metal gas tanks, kitchen cookers and utensils, and some disposable dishware. The train car itself could be used in a subway scene with a few simple modifications.
